name: Sadakane Ryouma
source:
A physically strong curator who promotes chimeras. His dream is to make Shichiyou into the zoo that leaves its mark in history. Tends to be insensitive to others' feelings. When starts talking about things he likes (chimeras) -  stops seeing anything around him.
Likes: Muscle training, Chimera research
Dislikes: Tsukigata Mitora, Snakes
